tldr: Morning batch (Sep 1): Anthropic publicly disclosed its cyber-evaluation containment incidents and the security hardening built ahead of Mythos-class models, while Hermes Agent v0.21.0 shipped Agent-2-Agent comms, Bots Mode, and a ~50% default context cut. Regulation and money moved: the EU classified ChatGPT as a 'very large search engine' under the DSA, OpenAI's ad business hit a $1B annualized run rate and moved to outcome-based pricing for large customers, and the Bank of England warned G20 finance ministers that AI valuations and leverage could trigger the next financial crisis. In hardware, China's CXMT began small-batch HBM3E production, closing the AI memory gap. Papers: Code as Worlds and LoopArena push agentic evaluation beyond static Q&A, and Garry Tan published SOTA evals for his GBrain agent-memory retrieval layer.
